title: Angles in Triangles & Quadrilaterals
welcome_lead: Three sides give 180°. Four sides give 360°. Master the angle rules of common shapes.
meta_desc: Learn angle rules in triangles and quadrilaterals in this KS3 geometry adventure.
final_note: Brilliant! Triangle and quadrilateral angles are clear.

concepts.def: The amount of turn between two lines, in degrees.
Triangle with three equal sides and angles.
Triangle with two equal sides and angles.

walkthroughs.body_html:
The three angles in any triangle add to 180°.

If two angles are 60° and 80°, the third is 180 − 60 − 80 = 40°.

The four angles in any quadrilateral add to 360°.

If three angles are 90°, 100°, 80°, the fourth is 360 − 270 = 90°.

All three sides equal means all three angles equal.

180 ÷ 3 = 60° each.
